name: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co., Ltd.
business_model: Diversified chemicals group; semiconductor materials include silicon wafers, photoresists, photomask blanks, synthetic quartz and encapsulating materials.

name: SUMCO Corporation
business_model: Pure-play silicon wafer maker (polished and epitaxial 300 mm and 200 mm wafers), selling largely under long-term agreements for 300 mm.

name: Siltronic AG
business_model: Silicon wafer maker with fabs in Germany and Singapore; sells partly under long-term agreements.

name: Entegris, Inc.
business_model: Electronic materials and purity supplier: Materials Solutions (deposition precursors, CMP slurries and pads, implant gases, etch/clean chemistries) and Advanced Purity Solutions (filtration, purification, wafer and substrate handling).

name: Merck KGaA
business_model: Electronics sector's Semiconductor Solutions unit sells thin-film precursors, patterning materials (photoresists), CMP materials, specialty gases and delivery systems with on-site services (MEGASYS).

name: Resonac Holdings Corporation
business_model: Chemicals group whose Semiconductor and Electronic Materials segment sells front-end materials (electronic gases, CMP slurry) and back-end packaging materials (mold compounds, die bonding materials, laminates).

name: JSR Corporation
business_model: Photoresist and semiconductor materials maker; since April 2024 a subsidiary of JICC-02 (JIC funds) after a tender offer, with delisting from the Tokyo Stock Exchange scheduled.
investors: JICC-02, Ltd. (JIC PEFJ1 Limited Partnership 97%, JIC PEF1 Limited Partnership 3%)

name: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd.
business_model: Photoresist and process-chemical maker covering g/i-line, KrF, ArF and EUV resists plus developers, thinners and strippers.
products: g/i-line, KrF, ArF and EUV photoresists

name: Linde plc
hq_country: United Kingdom / United States (incorporated in Ireland)
business_model: Industrial gases supplied on-site (pipeline, 10-20 year contracts), merchant bulk (3-7 year contracts) and packaged; electronics is one end market.

name: Air Liquide S.A.
business_model: Industrial gases group with an Electronics business selling carrier gases, specialty materials and equipment and installation.

name: Ajinomoto Co., Inc.
business_model: Food company that also makes Ajinomoto Build-up Film (ABF), the insulating film used in high-end IC package substrates.
